name: get_stats
description: Token-cheap document census for a session: words, paragraphs, tables, callouts, images, and an estimated editorial page budget (layout-weighted by words, tables, images, and explicit page breaks) in a single small envelope. Counters are the exact engine counters behind CLI stats, so both surfaces always agree. Physical pagination is finalized when exporting to PDF via LibreOffice. Read-only: never mutates, never bumps the revision. Returns {ok:true,sessionId,revision,dirty,words,paragraphs,tables,callouts,images,pages}. A callout (a "> [!NOTE]" alert or a callout op: a one-cell table with a fill) is counted in callouts and not in tables. Use instead of inspect_document when only counts are needed (a full TOON dump costs thousands of tokens for the same question). Example {"sessionId":"sess_abc"} -> {"ok":true,"words":42,"paragraphs":5}.
